workItem: Correlate the 28 currently relevant roadmap documents and implement a repository-wide single-source model where each canonical project roadmap owns organizational project execution status while bounded technical authorities, domain detail roadmaps and historical evidence remain preserved.
workItemDE: Die 28 aktuell relevanten Roadmap-Dokumente korrelieren und ein repositoryweites Single-Source-Modell umsetzen: je kanonischem Projekt genau eine organisatorische Projektstatus-Roadmap; technische Authorities, Fachdetails und historische Evidence bleiben erhalten.
ownerRole: Governance coordination under active ADR-0104 Human Owner delegated execution session; project/domain ownership and technical authority remain with their canonical owners and authorities.

overlapGuard.reason: PR #679 actively writes both Documentary roadmap paths; this consolidation classifies them in the registry but does not mutate those paths until that writer terminalizes. Their existing roles already align with the target model.

authorityGuard: This work changes roadmap role/status-source semantics only. It must not demote /AGENTS.md, accepted ADR/ESS/AUTH/CTRL authority, AUTH-GOV-DEVELOPMENT-CHAIN-STATUS, SC-MD-SPT-0001 or other bounded technical authorities. Exact main SHAs remain observational evidence, not permanent authority.
releaseCondition: Release after the consolidation PR is merged, closed, superseded or abandoned.
